annotations.text:
What changed from the build you have:

• Gradients removed. The old PLAY button was a green gradient — the single most generic thing on the screen. Now flat colour with a hard bevel.

• Corners squared. 8px radii softened everything; the game is made of cubes.

• Buttons carry the real stone texture from the atlas, pixel-crisp.

• Archivo instead of Segoe UI — sturdier, more character, same metrics family.
The press is the whole trick: the bevel inverts and the face drops 4px, so the light that was on top is suddenly underneath. That reads as a physical push in a way a colour change never does.
